name: hello-ios-example
description: Sample iOS staticlib: tishlang_ui JSX + tish:ios run()

scripts.build: cargo run --manifest-path ../../../../../tish/Cargo.toml -q -p tishlang -- build --target native --native-backend rust --crate-type staticlib --ios-triple aarch64-apple-ios-sim src/main.tish -o dist/hello-ios
scripts.dev: echo 'Link dist/hello-ios staticlib in an Xcode iOS app target.'
